# Konneqta

> Konneqta — Connect Smarter, Beyond The Internet. A digital business card platform where every user gets a shareable profile with all their social links in one place, scannable via QR code.

Konneqta lets you create a single, beautiful link-in-bio style profile that consolidates all your contact info and social links. Each profile has a unique QR code for offline-to-online sharing, works offline as a PWA, and includes visitor analytics for the card owner.
